Alternative Bonus Offers
While many consider free spins to be some of the best offers available, there are plenty of alternative bonus offers available. Here are some of the most popular bonus types in Canada:
Exclusive bonuses
Find exclusive bonuses that are only offered to Bojoko's readers. These deals give you access to offers with enhanced value, such as higher bonus amounts or improved wagering conditions
Exclusive bonuses »
No wagering bonuses
No wagering bonuses allow you to keep your winnings without having to meet playthrough requirements. This means any profits you earn from the bonus can usually be withdrawn straight away.
No wagering deals »
Slots bonuses
Slots bonuses are designed for players who love spinning the reels. These promotions often focus on popular titles or new releases, giving you more chances to explore different themes, features, and jackpots.
Slots bonuses »
Free Spins for Deposits
You can also get spins for practically nothing when you find casinos that offer bonuses on small deposits. For example, $1 minimum deposit casinos like Grizzly Quest and Zodiac Casino credit your account with bonus spins when you deposit just one dollar.
Responsible Gambling
Free spins can be fun bonuses and genuinely useful for trying out a casino, but it's important to remember that they are still marketing tools. Casinos don't offer free spins just out of generosity; they use them to introduce you to their platform and encourage you to keep playing.
Some offers are even structured to encourage repeated play, such as free spins released over multiple days. Logging in daily can quickly turn into a habit, and the more you play, the higher the risk of spending more than you intended.
This kind of excessive gambling can be avoided by setting suitable responsible gambling limits on your account. Casinos offer various tools that can be used to control your spending, such as:
- Deposit limit: Limits how much you can deposit daily/weekly/monthly
- Session limit: Limits how long one gambling session can last before automatic logout
- Wager limit: Limits how many wagers can be made during a certain time period
- Loss limit: Limits how much you can lose in a set time period
If you feel like gambling is becoming problematic, please see the following Canadian support channels for responsible gambling help.
